title: FleetRing capabilities
description: What FleetRing can do, what is built and what is planned. fleetring.dev reads docs/capabilities.json at build time, so a pull request that adds or ships a capability updates it. The site shows a built capability as Released once the latest published release of its component is at least its `since`, and as Planned until then, so publishing a release needs no edit here.

format.description: The version of this file's shape. Changes only with the site's reader.

areas.description: The groups the site shows capabilities in, in page order.

id.description: Stable and unique; the site links to it. Never reuse one.

component.description: Whose release `since` counts: the placement crate on crates.io, or the daemon's fleetringd-v* releases.

title.description: A few words, in lexicon terms.

description.description: One plain sentence for users, in lexicon terms (fleet, never cluster). No version numbers, no invented figures, no exclamation marks, and none of: simply, just, magic, blazing.

status.description: built: merged on main. planned: designed or ticketed, not built.

since.description: For built capabilities: the release of `component` it first ships in. For work merged after the latest release, the next version.

ticket.description: The FR number. Omit only when no ticket exists yet; then `docs` links the roadmap epic.

issue.description: The GitHub issue, when the ticket is one.

docs.description: Where to read more: an ADR, a README section, a plan, or the issue.
